Team — forwarding a customer erasure request (MediLedger / ML-8890). They asked for deletion of prompt outputs, request/response logs, transient model traces, and KV cache entries. Timeline they requested is fast; I proposed a 2–3 business day MAP.

Please treat this as an operational runbook task. Below is the checklist I'd like us to run and record in runbook_log_20270720.txt. I will coordinate the external communications once we have the evidence.

Redwood erasure checklist (targeted purge, internal ops runbook)
1) Identify scope
   - Confirm whether the purge is account-wide or subject-record-specific (waiting on customer detail).
2) Hot-store deletion
   - Remove prompt-output files from hot object store path: s3://redwood-prod/outputs/ml-8890/*
   - Expunge request/response logs from streaming service (retention topic: live-requests-ml-8890).
3) KV cache sweep
   - Flush any per-session KV caches in serving runtime for ML-8890; clear shard-local caches and invalidate index entries.
4) Cold-store/cold backups
   - Run audit queries against glacier-tier archives for keys matching ML-8890; where present, mark records for deletion per our cold-store TTL policy and note expected retention windows.
5) Telemetry/analytics
   - Ensure aggregated analytics (non-identifying) remain intact unless flagged by legal. If any telemetry includes identifiers, flag for removal.
6) Evidence collection
   - Save runbook_log (timestamps, operator ids, commands executed, job ids).
   - Generate erasure_receipt PDF with signed hash and list of deleted namespaces.
7) Verification
   - Run read queries to prove absence of prompt outputs in identified buckets (screenshot/CLI output saved).
8) Delivery
   - Send erasure_receipt + runbook_log to customer and update ticket HL-4927.

Action items: Vivek: please schedule the purge job and do the hot-store + KV sweep. Neha: quick review for any compliance/legal flags (cold backups or holds). Marissa: stand by to prepare the receipt and sign off on the final email to the customer.

Note: attach redwood-erasure-checklist-v1.3.md as our template for the runbook. Add operator notes inline in runbook_log_20270720.txt.

Thanks — Soojin
